name: Elowen Harrowmont
source_profile:
Marquessa Elowen “Lady Harrow” Harrowmont 
A politically astute noblewoman from an influential northern family, Elowen understands that 
Cador's reconstruction depends on lumber. Her polished manners conceal a remarkably 
ruthless negotiator, particularly when dealing with the elven coalition. 
Marquisate of Redvale 
The ranching marquisate seated at the town of Redvale.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 17–17 (source excerpt)
